720-1806-1829-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-1829-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

206-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
206-2105-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

710-1258-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
710-1258-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7229-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power X or greater, or you have a creature card in your graveyard with power X or greater.
6972-7229-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2178-2438-5931-5970.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
2178-2438-5931-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Awakening Hall.
Awakening Hall triggers, returning all creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing one of the returned creatures.
When the creature dies, Marina triggers, and Funeral Room triggers if it's unlocked.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, if applicable, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Awakening Hall.
Repeat steps 3 through 7 once.
Repeat from step 1.
2178-2438-5931-5970.notes: If you start the combo with Funeral Room locked, you can still unlock it with Marina if you have three or more creature cards in your graveyard. During the first loop, you'll want to repeat steps 3 through 8 one additional time, instead choosing to unlock Funeral Room. Additional Marina triggers can allow you to lock and/or unlock other Rooms as desired.

271-618-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Goblin Electromancer.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

4659-5747-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Simulacrum Synthesizer.
When the Simulacrum Synthesizer token enters, its first ability and the nontoken Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, causing you to scry 2.
Resolve the nontoken Simulacrum Synthesizer's trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Simulacrum Synthesizer.
When the Simulacrum Synthesizer token enters, its first ability and each other Simulacrum Synthesizer's second ability trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to scry 2.
Resolve each other trigger, creating that many 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing a Simulacrum Synthesizer token and two Constructs, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4742-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

465-2034-4681.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 3.

2781-3817-6797.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4027-4986--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Glint Hawk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Glint Hawk enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glint Hawk.
Repeat.
2034-4027-4986--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3011-4090-5934.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
3011-4090-5934.notablePrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
3011-4090-5934.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
3011-4090-5934.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

3525-6723-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1020-3375-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2946-5231-6701.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2946-5231-6701.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-5231-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

222-2060-2438-6701.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
Szarel has power 4 or greater or you have another creature card in your graveyard.
222-2060-2438-6701.description:
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and up to one other creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, and the other creature returned in step 1, if applicable.
When Slimefoot and Squee and up to one other creature are sacrificed, Szarel triggers that many times, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler for each trigger.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
222-2060-2438-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4289-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

295-6562.description:
Cast Viscid Lemures by paying {4}{B}
When Viscid Lemures enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscid Lemures by paying {0}, giving it -1/-0 and swampwalk until end of turn.
Repeat step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the difference between Viscid Lemures' power and toughness.

3918-4038-4851.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

413-1077-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
413-1077-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 2.

4772-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

1561-5919.description:
Cast Peer into the Abyss by paying {4}{B}{B}{B}, causing an opponent to draw cards equal to half their library and causing them to lose half their life total, rounded up.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
If the opponent has 0 or less life, the opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger and/or until the opponent loses the game.

235-3681-4150.description:
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent thirteen poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

2034-3490-3887-4871-5375.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
When the Rat dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

328-338-4013-4929.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Cryptic Trilobite.
328-338-4013-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Cryptic Trilobite triggers, putting at least two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

717-779-2353-2924.description:
Cast Raven's Crime from your graveyard by paying {B} and discarding Dakmor Salvage, targeting any player.
Bone Miser and Niv-Mizzet's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Raven's Crime, causing target player to discard a card.
Repeat.

1039-2393-3358.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
1039-2393-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
